cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a mixed, rotational tape, 57% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.59% · WTI +0.39% · Brent +0.42% · NatGas +1.64%. At the last close, 57% of 67 energy names were green — a mixed, rotational tape. Nuclear & Uranium did the heavy lifting at +3.09%.

cards.headline: Nuclear & Uranium leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Nuclear & Uranium at +3.09%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -1.65%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
